title: TPK store state
description: state.json in $APPLOCALDATA/tpk/. Each of the three states names the layers it consists of by content hash; promotion is a single atomic write of this file, never a sequence of renames. Layers live in layers/<file_sha256>.tpk and are garbage-collected by reference counting.

pointer.description: Which revision the running process loaded.

install_id.description: Random UUIDv4 generated on first launch. Used for staged-rollout bucketing; survives reset so a device does not re-roll its bucket.

boot_attempts.description: How many times the current booting revision has started without being acknowledged. Below the threshold the revision is retried rather than rolled back: an OS kill, a power loss or a user quitting the app are ordinary events on mobile and must not be mistaken for a bad pack. Cleared by notify_ready.

consecutive_rollbacks.description: At the threshold check() reports degraded without touching the network, and status() reports degraded. Blacklisting only breaks the loop for one pack; this breaks it for the device. Cleared by a successful notify_ready or by reset.

last_watermark.description: Highest watermark seen, keyed by channel. A single scalar would make a stable->beta->stable switch discard every stable manifest forever.

version_floor.description: Highest version_code ever committed, keyed by pack id. Raised when a revision is committed, never lowered, and it survives reset. Distinct from what is installed: blacklisting a layer removes it from the stack, so the planner must stop counting it as installed, but an older signed pack for that id must still be refused. Only a strictly lower version_code is a downgrade; equality is a reinstall, which is what lets reset re-fetch the current version. Backfilled when the store opens, from the committed revision's layers and from blacklist entries other than not_acknowledged, so a state.json written by an older build is protected from its first launch.

min_key_epoch.description: Monotonic floor on signing key generation. Raised only by a verified channel manifest's key_epoch; survives reset.

last_error.description: The last failure that kept a revision from reaching staged. Cleared by a successful stage and by an acknowledgement; absent does not mean the last check succeeded.

file_sha256.description: Also the file name in layers/. Verified when staged; size and mtime_ns are recorded alongside it.
